supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Clamp lower start by range start, lower-bound exclusive end. If nonempty direct index Order search precedes candidate gate; exact bearish Order high predicate otherwise low. Candidate gate uses truthiness, not identity.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Fallback mode sets gate/family only, no qualifier lookup until after race; normal obtains valid ordinal's Reset Blue or null and first sorted confirmation strictly after behavior start. Filter null, choose minimum of one or both then max gate, restricted lower bound. No qualifiers gives null candidate without query.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Fallback flag triggers one independent first strict candidate search. Both absent returns null. Equal positions returns null even if candidate would not qualify in fallback. Nonnull Order and absent/later candidate wins red. Equal event timestamps at distinct positions do not invoke same-position guard.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Candidate surviving race asserted nonnull. Fallback mode upgrades only if S34 or S35 true at event, ordered short circuit; normal family already blue. Mapping and main timestamp after qualification. Assertion runtime config retained.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Only empty lower interval enters main fallback. Start uses original supplied start, not scan_start, upper-bound predecessor clamped to selected main start; nominal end inclusive. Candidate strict crossing AND (gate null or event>=gate). Order predicate evaluated independently even when candidate false. Both true immediately null before qualifier. Order wins red.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Candidate qualification after ambiguity and Order gates. S34 then S35, returns blue if either; fallback flag otherwise returns fallback; if unqualified normal, continue later main rows. Main time used for both event and main slots, native Candle.index returned.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Unpack caller tuples, construct frozen type3 blue record. Parent index int, source time from parent object; all Order fields null. Preserve Reset number/time and supplied candidate/decision tuple unchanged; no lifecycle acceptance or extra price normalization.

findings.description: Explicit lower index dependency and evaluation order.
findings.resolution: Find opposite Order stop independently using first_greater if order_direction bearish else first_less across entire window, before candidate qualification. Nonempty lower route calls lower_index directly, without a local null-index guard.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: Distinguish raw position ambiguity from qualification or timestamp equality.
findings.resolution: identical non-null position => null (ambiguous), before fallback candidate qualification; equal timestamps at distinct positions do not satisfy this guard.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.
